description: This file defines the ContextDefinition class used for plugin context annotations in Drupal, including its constructor, methods, and related documentation.

classes.name: ContextDefinition
classes.description: Defines a Drupal plugin annotation for context definitions, supporting configuration like label, required, default value, and class type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ContextDefinition object with provided annotation values, validating class implementation and setting default properties.

methods.name: getDefinitionClass
methods.description: Determines the appropriate class for the context definition based on annotation values, defaulting to specific or generic classes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the context definition object associated with this annotation.
